name: dsh-vscode-ext-host
description: Run real VS Code extension packages (VSIX) inside DeepSeek Harness: a vendored open source VS Code extension host, the store that installs extensions, a stdio language-server provider and the Extensions view — one plugin suite, four plugin rows.
author: Ethan Song

scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:protocol && npm run build:client && npm run build:console && npm run build:webview
scripts.verify: node runtime/verify/run.mjs && node runtime/verify/webview-e2e.mjs && node runtime/verify/bundle-smoke.mjs && node runtime/verify/client-preview.mjs && node runtime/verify/view-tab.mjs
